name: e2e
description: End-to-end test agent skills, grafted from sonhyrd/e2e-skills as an editable git subtree. pw-prove: prove a PR/branch/ticket/diff with a Playwright E2E test, fast. e2e-reviewer: static review of Playwright/Cypress specs and Page Objects, catching tests that pass CI but prove nothing. playwright-debugger: root-cause diagnosis of failed Playwright runs from reports, traces and screenshots. They are model-invocable so they can chain: pw-prove into e2e-reviewer at its quality gate, and a review skill into pw-prove, which confirms before a model-invoked run.
